NeurIPS+ICML: ICML 2021 test of time: not verified. The official ICML 2021 awards page (https://icml.cc/virtual/2021/awards_detail) lists only outstanding papers and honorable mentions. The URLs I tried for an ICML 2021 award or test-of-time page returned 404, and web search found nothing usable. No entry was added.

NeurIPS 2026: not included because the conference had not happened as of 2026-11-18. The official blog (https://blog.neurips.cc/2026/) gives the dates as Dec 6-12, 2026 in Sydney, with satellites in Atlanta and Paris Dec 9-13. https://neurips.cc/virtual/2026/awards_detail has no awards yet, and no NeurIPS 2026 test-of-time post was found.

Non-standard award labels: ICML position-track awards (2025 and 2026) are labelled 'outstanding_position' and 'honorable_mention_position'. ICML test-of-time honorable mentions (2022 and 2025) are labelled 'test_of_time_honorable_mention'. NeurIPS Datasets & Benchmarks awards are labelled 'outstanding_db' as instructed; this includes the 2024 and 2025 D&B 'Best Paper' awards. Drop or relabel these if only main-track research papers are wanted.

ICML 2023: the official awards_detail page lists only 4 of the 6 outstanding papers. 'Self-Repellent Random Walks...' and 'Bayesian Design Principles...' come from the official https://icml.cc/Conferences/2023/Awards page, which lists all six.

NeurIPS 2022: the official awards page lists all 15 papers under 'Outstanding Paper' with no track split. The blog post was used to separate them: ProcTHOR is main track, and LAION-5B and MineDojo are D&B.

Title variants: the ICML 2026 blog capitalises 'High-Accuracy Sampling for Diffusion Models and Log-Concave Distributions', but the awards page title ('High-accuracy sampling...') is used here. The ICML 2022 title keeps the page's LaTeX '$\mathcal{V}$-Usable'. The ICML 2020 test-of-time title is as printed on the page ('Bandit Settings'), without the page's 'Test of Time:' prefix.

arXiv IDs: only Faster R-CNN (1506.01497) appeared on a page I opened; all other arxiv_id fields are empty. paper_year for test-of-time papers comes from each announcement's 'published N years ago' statement or the original venue year it names.

No second independent source was checked for most venue-years. Each list comes from one official page, plus a second official page where noted. Shared artifact with the source list and caveats: award_papers_neurips_icml_2020_2026.
ICLR+COLM+CVPR+ICCV+ECCV: COLM 2024: no award list found. colmweb.org/2024/ has no awards section, colm.cc/virtual/2024/awards_detail is empty, and web search returned only irrelevant results. Not verified.
COLM 2025: no award list found. colmweb.org/2025/ has no awards section, colm.cc/virtual/2025/awards_detail is empty, and web search returned only irrelevant results. Not verified.

ICLR 2020: no outstanding-paper announcement found and iclr.cc/virtual/2020/awards_detail is empty. The ICLR outstanding paper program seems to have started in 2021 (not proven). ICLR test of time starts in 2024, as assigned.

ICLR 2021: the official post (iclr-conf.medium.com/announcing-iclr-2021-outstanding-paper-awards-9ae0514734ab) returned HTTP 403. The titles come from VinAI's verbatim repost, which links back to the original (secondary source). The 2021 post lists 8 Outstanding Paper winners and no honorable mentions.

ICLR test-of-time runner-ups (2024: Intriguing properties of neural networks; 2025: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate) are coded award='runner_up'. They are Test of Time runner-ups, not best-paper runner-ups.

CVPR 2020-2022: cvpr2022.thecvf.com was unreachable and the Wayback Machine returned HTTP 429. These years come from the IEEE CS TCPAMI official award list (tc.computer.org/tcpami/awards/cvpr-paper-awards/), not the conference site. That list may be missing best-student honorable mentions for these years.
CVPR test of time = Longuet-Higgins Prize (TCPAMI). Included from the TCPAMI list and the CVPR 2024/2025 news pages. award_year is the prize year; paper_year is the original CVPR year.

ICCV 2021/2025 and ICCV best-student/HM entries come from the TCPAMI official list (tc.computer.org/tcpami/awards/iccv-paper-awards/). The ICCV virtual award pages had no usable titles (2025 lists only Highlights; 2023 returns 404). The ICCV 2025 HM list may be incomplete.

ICCV 2023 Marr Prize (MEDIUM confidence for ControlNet): the official opening slides say 'Joint Award – 2 papers'. Only the 'Passive Ultra-Wideband Single-Photon Imaging' title could be extracted as text. 'Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models' is on the slides' award-candidate list and is included as the second co-winner. TCPAMI lists only Passive Ultra-Wideband. Needs one more check.
ICCV test of time = Helmholtz Prize, from the TCPAMI list. ECCV test of time = Koenderink Prize, from the ECVA pages.

ECCV 2020/2022: taken from the ECVA official ECCV Awards listing (www.ecva.net/index.php). That listing has no year labels; I assigned years by the order of its sections (2024, 2022, 2020, 2018...). The 2024 section matches eccv.ecva.net/Conferences/2024/Awards. ECCV 2024 'Award Candidate' papers (not winners) are excluded.

Title wording follows each source as printed. TCPAMI sometimes changes capitalization (e.g. 'Planning-Oriented'); where the conference page was available, its wording was used. The ICCV 2021 title 'Common Objects in 3D: LargeScale…' is printed that way in TCPAMI and was normalized to 'Large-Scale'.
arXiv IDs are given only where the official page printed them (the ICLR test-of-time posts). Other IDs were not looked up.
Evidence notes are stored in artifact 'aw_iclr_cv2_award_evidence'.
ACL+EMNLP+NAACL: Parsed (by the root agent, two researcher sub-agents for this branch were lost by the swarm) from the official pages 2023.aclweb.org/program/best_papers/, 2024.aclweb.org/program/best_papers/, 2025.aclweb.org/program/awards/, 2023.emnlp.org/program/best_papers/, 2024.emnlp.org/program/best_papers/: best, special (resource/social impact/theme), outstanding papers and honorable mentions; demo, SRW, SAC/area-chair, TACL and video awards excluded. ACL 2020-2022, ACL 2026, EMNLP 2020-2022/2025 and NAACL award lists are not included (not collected).
ACL 2023 special awards (reproduction/resource/social impact/theme) are printed in a different layout on the page and were not parsed.
